You shift your appearance to resemble a creature within 30 feet but with an unsettling, horrifying twist. Though this transformation is momentary, witnessing it gives the target deep existential dread. It must succeed at a Will save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC or become frightened 1 (frightened 2 on a critical failure) and be stupefied 1 as long as the frightened condition lasts. Once you’ve used Warped Reflection against a creature, it’s temporarily immune for 24 hours. 5TH LEVEL

mistaken_identity.name: Mistaken Identity
mistaken_identity.description: Frequency once per minute saving throw against a mental effect. You feel a strong connection with your progenitor and can convince yourself an effect targeting your mind was meant for theirs instead, allowing you to shrug off harmful effects. Roll the saving throw twice, and take the higher result. However, subsuming your identity is disturbing, and you’re frightened 1.

reflective_pocket.name: Reflective Pocket
reflective_pocket.description: You’ve formed a connection with a small hand mirror, allowing you to use it as an extradimensional storage space. You can store one item of light Bulk in your mirror at a time. Storing or retrieving an item requires an Interact action and any creature can do so. While an item is stored within the mirror, the mirror 120120 Cloning Dish

replicate.name: Replicate
replicate.description: You’ve learned to reshape your malleable form. You can cast illusory disguise once per day as an innate occult spell. This is a transmutation and morph effect, as your body physically transforms, rather than an illusion effect.

warp_likeness.name: Warp Likeness
warp_likeness.requirements: You hit a creature with a melee Strike on your
warp_likeness.description: Frequency once per minute last action. You channel some of your own nature through your blow, temporarily warping your target’s form to resemble your own. The creature you hit must attempt a Fortitude save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. Critical Success The target is unaffected. Success The target resists the effect but its form twists in the process. It’s clumsy 1 until the end of its next turn. Failure The target’s body briefly warps to resemble yours. It’s clumsy 1 until the end of its next turn and sickened 1. Critical Failure The target’s body warps to resemble yours for a significant time. It’s clumsy 1 for 1 minute and sickened 2. 9TH LEVEL

mirror_refuge.name: Mirror Refuge
mirror_refuge.requirements: You’re within 5 feet of a mirrored surface.
mirror_refuge.description: CONJURATION EXTRADIMENSIONAL OCCULT REFLECTION Frequency once per day Your origin in the space behind mirrors enables you to use a mirror as a hideaway, like the spell meld into stone. You meld into an adjacent mirror. You can hear but not see outside this space, and creatures outside can’t see or hear you. You can cast spells while within the mirror, but no effects can cross the mirror. Your Mirror Refuge lasts for 10 minutes unless the mirror is broken, which expels you and deals 10d6 damage to you. You can Dismiss the effect. You appear in a space adjacent to the mirror when the effect ends.

two_truths.name: Two Truths
two_truths.description: Your ability to imitate your progenitor is so strong, you can even convince yourself. When you use this action, you alter your thought processes to your progenitor or from your progenitor back to yourself. As long as what you say is true from the point of view of your current identity, you can say it even under effects like zone of truth that force you to speak truly.

unyielding_disguise.name: Unyielding Disguise
unyielding_disguise.prereq: ability to cast humanoid form or illusory disguise
unyielding_disguise.description: When you cast humanoid form or illusory disguise to alter your appearance, the spell’s duration is 2 hours. At the end of the duration, you can extend the spell’s duration for another hour, but doing so is taxing, making you drained 1. You can keep extending it in this way, increasing your drained condition by 1 each time, to a maximum duration of 6 hours. 13TH LEVEL

malleable_form.name: Malleable Form
malleable_form.prereq: ability to cast at least one polymorph spell
malleable_form.requirements: You’re polymorphed by a spell that has multiple
malleable_form.description: choices of battle form. You adroitly shift your form, taking on another appearance. Choose a different battle form of the polymorph spell affecting you, and change to that form instead of the current one. This destabilizes the spell’s magic, reducing its duration by 1 round. Use the level of the spell to determine the statistics, as normal.

redirect_attention.name: Redirect Attention
redirect_attention.description: Through your strong connection with your progenitor, you’re able to redirect those attempting to spy on you. Whenever you would be directly targeted with a scrying effect, the effect must attempt a counteract check against the higher of your spell DC or class DC. If the check fails, the effect targets your progenitor instead of you. 17TH LEVEL

reflect_foe.name: Reflect Foe
reflect_foe.description: You create a copy of a foe by calling them forth from a nearby reflection, clonally growing them in an instant from one of your hairs or otherwise creating them in a way that matches your own nature as a reflection. You can cast duplicate foe once per day as an innate occult spell. At 20th level, your innate duplicate foe is heightened to 8th level. FINAL USURPATION If your progenitor is deceased, you might be able to take over their life. It might require a special ritual and other activities taking 1 week, as you take over your progenitor’s lodgings, activities, relationships, and so on. Once you finish, provided no creature has successfully identified you as an impostor, the memories of everyone who knew or interacted with your progenitor are altered, so they forget your

alter_ego_dedication.name: Alter Ego Dedication
alter_ego_dedication.description: You make yourself into a living mirror, becoming a double of someone unremarkable, and you slip into exactly the role that can get you past security or into a sensitive facility. You become an expert in Deception. You gain the Assume a Role activity. Assume a Role (concentrate) Requirements You’ve spent at least 1 hour studying a creature whose role you intend to copy and have done so within the last 3 days. This could include meeting and learning from someone in that role, tailing and spying on someone, using magic to observe them at work, or some other method, as long as you have a visual source of information; Effect You quickly and accurately learn how to do mundane jobs or at least copy the movements enough to appear as if you do. A chosen role can take many forms—from cook, cleaner, or librarian

change_of_face.name: Change Of Face
change_of_face.description: You know that for the best disguise to work, one requires not only the right skills but also the right look—luckily you can copy both using special magical techniques. When you Impersonate, you don’t need a disguise kit; instead, simple illusions or temporary transmutations ripple over your body like mirror shards, providing the supplies that the kit ordinarily would. When you Impersonate in this way, your Impersonate activity gains the occult trait. 126126

fake_it_till_you_make_it.name: Fake It Till You Make It
fake_it_till_you_make_it.description: When you take on a role, you become more capable with all sorts of tasks involving that role. When you Assume a Role, choose two skills associated with the role in some way; if you’re untrained, you can use your level as your proficiency bonus for those skills, and you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to skill checks with those skills as long as you remain in that role. You and the GM determine which skills you assume.

in_plain_sight.name: In Plain Sight
in_plain_sight.description: People often only see what they want to see, a weakness you know how to take full advantage of. While you’ve Assumed a Role, you can use Deception in place of Stealth when using the Avoid Notice exploration activity in an area where someone with your role wouldn’t be unusual, such as when impersonating a sailor or fisher when infiltrating the docks.

sound_mirror.name: Sound Mirror
sound_mirror.description: You twist not just the visual, but the auditory as well, allowing you to pass without a sound and create minor noises as distractions—perfect for misdirection and infiltration. You can cast silence on yourself as a 2nd-level innate occult spell and ventriloquism as a 1st-level innate occult spell, both once per day. You also can cast ghost sound as an innate occult cantrip. You become trained in occult spell attack rolls and spell DCs, and your key spellcasting ability is Charisma.

muscle_mimicry.name: Muscle Mimicry
muscle_mimicry.prereq: Alter Ego Dedication; trained in Athletics,
muscle_mimicry.trigger: An enemy makes a successful Disarm, Escape,
muscle_mimicry.description: master in Deception Grapple, Shove, or Trip attempt. Your study of another allows you to mirror their movements subtly, even in the heat of combat. You study the successful maneuver of an enemy and instinctively learn to do it. The next time you take the same action they did, you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to your Athletics check, or a +2 circumstance bonus if the enemy critically succeeded on their triggering action. You lose this benefit if you don’t use it before the end of your next turn.

swap_reflections.name: Swap Reflections
swap_reflections.description: ARCHETYPE CONJURATION EXTRADIMENSIONAL INCAPACITATION OCCULT TELEPORTATION Frequency once per 10 minutes You’ve learned how to use even your reflection to your advantage. You send your own reflection to forcibly swap places with the reflection of an enemy, pulling each of you through opposite ends and switching places. The enemy must be within 120 feet, you must both be adjacent to reflective surfaces (such as glass, mirrors, or calm water), and you must be able to see the target’s reflection and have line of effect to it. The target attempts a Will save against your spell DC or class DC, whichever is higher. Critical Success The spell has no effect. Success You swap positions with your target or arrive adjacent to your target, whichever your target prefers.

borrow_memories.name: Borrow Memories
borrow_memories.description: Knowing how someone thinks makes it much easier to know where they’ll be, or even replace them altogether. You can cast mind probe as an innate occult spell once per day, using your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher. If you cast mind probe on a target you’re studying for the purpose of Assuming their Role, and the target fails their save, you can delay the spell from coming into effect until you Assume their Role. When you use the spell this way, you can Sustain it up to 10 times during its duration, asking a question each time. The spell lasts until you ask all 10 questions or are no longer Assuming the Role, whichever comes first. You don’t need to Sustain the Spell to extend its duration—only when asking a question—nor do you need to be in range or have line of effect to Sustain it. ALTER EGOS IN GOLARION

living_vessel_dedication.name: Living Vessel Dedication
living_vessel_dedication.description: Whether willingly or not, you’ve become a vessel for a being of unimaginable power. You and your GM should work together to determine the being’s nature and decide how much you know and how much remains a mystery to you for now. Some decisions might influence your options later. You might need to decide whether the entity is a demon, for instance, to know if you qualify for later feats. You need to spend at least an hour each day assuaging the entity within you or you take a –1 penalty to Will saves for 24 hours. The process of assuaging the entity is determined together between you and the GM. It might be as simple as meditating with the entity to learn more about them, but it might be as extreme as committing gruesome, unspeakable sacrifices to keep their unknowable blessings. After a full week of failing to assuage your entity, you become doomed 1,

s_strike.name: S Strike
s_strike.description: The more you try to force your body to stay yours, the more it warps to channel the energy flowing through you. Whether you grow horns to match the wild hunt fey within you, develop a claw like that of the treachery demon sharing your soul, or feel a tentacle rip out of you from the outer being that imprinted itself on your psyche, the entity within you refuses to be contained. You gain an unarmed attack of your choice with its type determined by your entity. It deals 1d6 damage of a damage type appropriate for the unarmed attack (such as bludgeoning for the tentacle). This unarmed attack is in the brawling weapon group and has the agile, finesse, and magical traits.

tap_vitality.name: Tap Vitality
tap_vitality.description: ARCHETYPE CONCENTRATE HEALING NECROMANCY POSITIVE Frequency once per hour You tap into the entity’s life force to heal your wounds, though at the cost of the entity’s personality bleeding into your own. You recover a number of Hit Points equal to four times your level. Each time you use Tap Vitality, you begin to bleed more and more of the entity’s personality and instincts into your own until the next time you spend an hour or more assuaging the entity, bringing your mind back under your own control. Special This action has the tradition trait appropriate to your entity, typically divine for a demon, occult for an aberration or outer entity, or primal for a fey. 140140

exude_abyssal_corruption.name: Exude Abyssal Corruption
exude_abyssal_corruption.prereq: Living Vessel Dedication, your entity is a demon
exude_abyssal_corruption.description: Most of the changes from the demon within you have harmed you so far, but you’ve found a way to expel some of the corruption within you to poison others. Until the beginning of your next turn, you and your weapons are covered in toxic sludge or another similar manifestation of the demonic corruption; your melee Strikes deal an additional 1d6 poison damage, and each time a creature hits you with a melee unarmed attack or otherwise touches you, it takes 1d6 poison damage. At 14th level, the poison damage increases to 2d6, and at 20th level, the poison damage increases to 3d6.

s_trickery.name: S Trickery
s_trickery.description: is a fey Frequency once per hour You connect with the fey trickster within yourself to create whimsical illusory duplicates that distract your foes. This has the effects of mirror image.

warped_constriction.name: Warped Constriction
warped_constriction.requirements: You have a foe grabbed or restrained.
warped_constriction.description: your entity is an aberration or outer entity The entity inhabiting your body is an aberrant being with unfathomable motivations, and when you hold a foe close, tendrils and tentacles unfurl from your body to crush your foe and pollute it with alien wrongness. Your grabbed or restrained foe takes bludgeoning damage equal to your level and mental damage equal to your highest mental ability modifier. The creature attempts a basic Will save that applies to both types of damage and uses the higher of your class DC or spell DC.

s_form.name: S Form
s_form.description: Frequency once per day You symbiotically combine your form with that of the entity within you, taking a powerful hybrid form to temporarily boost your abilities in combat while maintaining control. For 1 minute, you gain the following effects. • If you were Medium or smaller, you become Large, and your reach increases to 10 feet. • You gain a +2 status bonus to attack and damage rolls and a +1 status bonus on saving throws against spells. If you use Entity’s Resurgence, the status bonuses to attack and damage rolls increase to +3 during the time that the two effects overlap. • If you have the Entity’s Strike feat, the unarmed attack you gained from that feat increases its damage die from 1d6 to 1d8.

pactbinder_dedication.name: Pactbinder Dedication
pactbinder_dedication.prereq: trained in Diplomacy as well as either Arcana,
pactbinder_dedication.description: Nature, Occultism, or Religion The first step toward forming a successful pact is an understanding of the magic behind it, along with skill at negotiation. It doesn’t hurt that you also learned how to magically bind yourself to keep your word, enabling you to bargain more easily. You increase your proficiency from trained to expert in Diplomacy and in one of the following: Arcana, Nature, Occultism, or Religion. Binding Vow [one-action] (auditory, concentrate, enchantment, occult) Frequency once per day; Effect You bind yourself by formally speaking a binding vow. Supernatural power flows through and around you as you speak it, and all those present to hear it intrinsically know that it binds you. Breaking this vow is anathema to you, and if you break it willingly, you lose all pactbinder benefits until you fulfill your vow or, if

sociable_vow.name: Sociable Vow
sociable_vow.description: You can leverage your vow in more social interactions. The circumstance bonus from your Binding Vow also applies to attempts to Gather Information, Make an Impression, or Demoralize you make directly in service of fulfilling the vow.

pact_of_fey_glamour.name: Pact Of Fey Glamour
pact_of_fey_glamour.description: You’ve sworn a pact with fey powers, granting you the otherworldly appearance of your dreams in exchange for oaths of hospitality. As long as you keep your end of the bargain, your base appearance changes indefinitely to any one appearance you wish that’s within the bounds of possibility for your ancestry; this effect can’t be counteracted or removed except by violating the pact. Additionally, you can cast illusory disguise as a primal innate spell once per hour, using the higher of your class DC and your spell DC to determine the DC. In exchange, you promise to accept any fey’s request for hospitality, granting them food, drink, and lodging for up to 3 days and 3 nights. You also promise not to harm any creature to whom you’ve offered hospitality or who has shown hospitality to you, whether or not that creature is fey, unless that creature does harm first. If you refuse hospitality to a fey

pact_of_draconic_fury.name: Pact Of Draconic Fury
pact_of_draconic_fury.description: You’ve sworn a pact with a dragon, giving you the ability to tap into the dragon’s immeasurable power in exchange for adding to their hoard. You gain the Dragon Breath activity. In exchange, you promise to search for objects the dragon wants for its hoard upon request. These requests might be extremely specific unique objects, or they might be a broad category of objects. While the dragon agrees to pay you a fair price for the item you retrieve, the pact requires you to give your time and service. Dragon Breath [two-actions] Frequency once per hour; Effect You breathe deeply and exhale a line or cone of powerful breath, much like the dragon with which you made the pact. If the dragon had a cone-shaped breath weapon, your breath weapon is a 166166

pact_of_infernal_prowess.name: Pact Of Infernal Prowess
pact_of_infernal_prowess.description: You’ve sworn a pact with devils, granting you success in life in exchange for your soul in the afterlife. Once per hour, when you critically fail a check, you can reroll the check as a free action; this is a fortune effect. Additionally, you can choose to automatically succeed at checks to Earn Income for tasks below your level, without rolling. However, when you die, your soul is consigned to Hell. You can’t be returned to life except by powerful magic such as miracle, and even then, the devils responsible for the contract can track your every move for 1 year. The devils gain the effects of a discern location spell. They can also use 10th-level scrying on you at will, and you automatically critically fail your saving throw. Special You can’t retrain out of a Pact of Infernal Prowess without journeying to Hell and destroying the

pact_of_the_final_breath.name: Pact Of The Final Breath
pact_of_the_final_breath.description: You’ve sworn a pact with a powerful psychopomp—typically an olethros advocate or yamaraj judge—granting you a reprieve before your soul will be collected in exchange for respect for the dead and assistance against the undead. As long as you keep your end of the bargain, you live twice as long as you normally would before dying of natural causes. Additionally, the first time each day that you would be reduced to 0 Hit Points and gain the dying condition, you instead regain a number of Hit Points equal to twice your level (starting from 0 HP), remain conscious, and gain fast healing equal to your level for 3 rounds. In exchange, you swear to treat the dead you come across with respect, performing last rites and final dispositions to ensure their spirits rest in peace and are less likely to

pact_of_eldritch_eyes.name: Pact Of Eldritch Eyes
pact_of_eldritch_eyes.description: You’ve sworn a pact with an entity beyond mortal comprehension, granting you distant visions and insights. You can cast prying eye as an occult innate spell once per hour, using the higher of your class DC and your spell DC to determine the DC. In exchange, you allow the entity to peer through you at your world. The entity’s touch creates strange dreams, typically nightmares. Every morning, you awaken trained in an unexpected Lore skill determined by the GM, which you retain until the next time you rest for the night. While the entity contacts you most often while you sleep, it occasionally peers at you during the day, leading to disorientation and visions. You can generally determine what’s going on during these visions, so normally this occurrence imparts no mechanical penalty. However, in the unlikely event that an encounter begins while you’re experiencing visions from the entity, you might take a

curse_maelstrom_dedication.name: Curse Maelstrom Dedication
curse_maelstrom_dedication.prereq: You are cursed or have previously been cursed.
curse_maelstrom_dedication.requirements: You are in a curse maelstrom state;
curse_maelstrom_dedication.description: A horrible curse has left a lingering stain on your soul, and its effects continue to plague you even if the curse’s other effects have ended. You can choose to suppress it, but if you instead let it manifest, you can channel its power in your favor. During an encounter, when you succeed at a check, the GM can offer to have you roll again, taking the second result. This is a misfortune effect. If you do so, you enter a curse maelstrom state. If the misfortune effect is somehow canceled or negated (by a fortune effect, for example), you don’t enter a curse maelstrom state. In addition, the curse is jealous of its place within your soul and gladly lashes out whenever others dare to usurp that position, granting you its power without the usual price. If a foe places a misfortune effect on your roll and the effect applies to your roll, you enter a curse maelstrom state, and

familiar_oddities.name: Familiar Oddities
familiar_oddities.description: Occultism or Curse Lore Perhaps due to the curse within you, curses occasionally perceive you as an extension of themselves and readily reveal themselves to you. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to checks to Identify Magic on a cursed item or a spell that has the curse trait.

unnerving_expansion.name: Unnerving Expansion
unnerving_expansion.description: You gather your curse around you and impel it to pour outward, expanding your maelstrom. The radius of the emanation of your curse maelstrom state increases by 5 feet until the end of your curse maelstrom state. The outpouring of the curse is unnerving. You attempt to Demoralize a creature within the emanation of your curse maelstrom; you don’t take penalties for not sharing a language with that creature.

share_burden.name: Share Burden
share_burden.trigger: An ally within 60 feet would be affected by a curse
share_burden.description: or misfortune effect, and you wouldn’t be affected but you are an eligible target for the effect. You draw the misfortune or curse into yourself, potentially enabling you to enter your curse maelstrom state. Instead of affecting your ally, the triggering curse or misfortune effect affects you.

accursed_magic.name: Accursed Magic
accursed_magic.description: When the curse within you spills out, you can lay curses on others and claim them for yourself with ease. You can cast claim curse (Secrets of Magic 95). At 10th level, you can also cast seal fate (Advanced Player’s Guide 224), and at 12th level, you can also cast inevitable disaster (Secrets of Magic 111). You can cast these spells once per day as occult innate spells, but only while within your curse maelstrom state. If you couldn’t already cast occult spells, these spells use Wisdom as your spellcasting ability, and you become trained in spell attack rolls and spell DCs for occult spells.

counter_curse.name: Counter Curse
counter_curse.requirements: You are in a curse maelstrom state.
counter_curse.trigger: ing effect, using half your level rounded up as your
counter_curse.description: the emanation of a curse or misfortune effect from an opponent or object of which you are aware. You gather the energy of your maelstrom and fling its unleashed power into the enemy’s curse, attempting to neutralize it. Attempt a counteract check against the counteract level and the higher of your class DC and spell DC as the counteract modifier. On a success, you neutralize the curse or misfortune effect. If the effect was constant, such as a misfortune aura, it returns automatically at the beginning of the creature or object’s next turn. Whether you succeed or fail, your curse maelstrom state ends.

torrential_backlash.name: Torrential Backlash
torrential_backlash.requirements: You are in a curse maelstrom state.
torrential_backlash.description: Calling upon forbidden practices, you release the curse from within yourself, allowing it free rein to destroy everything around you. All creatures within your curse maelstrom emanation except you take 1d6 negative damage for each level you have, with a basic Fortitude save. Your curse maelstrom state then ends.

reverse_curse.name: Reverse Curse
reverse_curse.description: When you counter a curse or misfortune effect, you send it back to destroy its originator. Whenever you succeed at the counteract check to Counter Curse, the creature is affected by its own curse or misfortune effect, attempting a saving throw against its own DC if the effect allows a saving throw. In the case of a constant ability, such as a misfortune aura, the creature is affected only until the beginning of its next turn, when the ability reasserts itself. MANIFESTATIONS Those at the center of a storm of curses often have peculiar manifestations that mark them as one of the unfortunate. Over time, even the places that they inhabit will begin to show signs of their presence: plants with bizarre growths, dust clouds that form strange symbols in the light, and floors

sacral_lord.name: Sacral Lord
sacral_lord.description: By right of ritual or sheer stubbornness, you have claimed rulership of the land. Claim a defined territory, such as a small section of forest or river, or a district of a larger city. Within its borders, you can cast detect magic, guidance, and sigil as innate divine cantrips, and you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Make an Impression on creatures that have the celestial, fiend, fey, monitor, or spirit traits. Special You and your land are linked. Changes to one mirror themselves on the other—if you’re depressed, gray rain and clammy mist might set in. These effects have no immediate mechanical impact, but they might give clues about problems afflicting the land.

sacral_monarch.name: Sacral Monarch
sacral_monarch.prereq: Sacral Lord, master in Occultism or Religion
sacral_monarch.description: You have come into your full powers and are truly a monarch of your realm, by your own definition at least. While in your territory, you can cast banishment and inevitable disaster (Secrets of Magic 111) as innate divine spells, each once per day. Sacral Gnome

time_mage_dedication.name: Time Mage Dedication
time_mage_dedication.prereq: You have a spellcasting class feature.
time_mage_dedication.description: You might be a novice in the temporal arts now, but in the future, you’ll hold time in the palm of your hand. As some of your future knowledge leaks back to your present self, you gain the delay consequence domain spell ( Pathfinder Lost Omens Gods & Magic 118). It costs 1 Focus Point to cast a focus spell. This feat grants a focus pool of 1 Focus Point that you can recover by using the Refocus activity to revisit moments from your past and contemplate futures yet to come. If you already knew delay consequence from a feat or ability that allows you to gain your choice of domain spell, such as Domain Initiate, then when you take this feat, you can retrain that option to gain a different domain spell instead as your personal timeline rearranges itself. You also gain time sense (page

chronocognizance.name: Chronocognizance
chronocognizance.prereq: Time Mage Dedication, master in Perception
chronocognizance.description: The flows and ebbs of time are obvious to you, as are the tangles that form when it’s distorted. You’re automatically aware if any creature that you observe is under the effects of the slowed or quickened conditions. You have a general idea when you’re in the vicinity of time-manipulating phenomena, though this grants you no particular insight into the specific effects of the anomaly. Particularly subtle temporal anomalies might still escape your notice, requiring a Perception check, as determined by the GM. If you’re legendary in Arcana, Nature, or Occultism, or Religion, 184184

s_secrets.name: S Secrets
s_secrets.description: The secrets of time peel back, revealing deeper truths. You gain either the stasis domain spell ( Gods & Magic 118) or the path of least resistance focus spell (below). Increase the number of Focus Points in your pool by 1. Special You can take this feat a second time, gaining the focus spell that you didn’t gain the first time. Increase the number of Focus Points in your pool by 1.

future_spell_learning.name: Future Spell Learning
future_spell_learning.description: More future memories of time magic percolate back to the present, teaching you spells you’ve yet to learn. Add behold the weave (page 181), cast into time (Secrets of Magic 94 ), haste, loose time’s arrow (page 182), quicken time (page 182), slow, and stagnate time (page 182) to your spell list. You can thus potentially learn these spells even if they aren’t normally on your tradition’s spell list.

what_could_have_been.name: What Could Have Been
what_could_have_been.description: Rather than conjuring creatures from elsewhere in the world or the planes, you can temporarily pull a much different version of yourself from an alternate timeline—for instance, instead of summoning a generic or random troll with summon giant , you summon a troll version of yourself from a timeline where you’re a troll. If your next action is to Cast a Spell that summons a creature, that creature is another version of you. This creature remains the type of creature you summoned and has largely the same abilities (plus the following adjustments), but it clearly resembles you, likely sharing some distinguishing features, such as mannerisms, speech patterns, tattoos, or clothing. The summoned creature gains a +1 status bonus to any skill check in which you’re trained, a +2 status bonus if you’re an expert, a +3 status bonus if you’re a master, or a +4 status

into_the_future.name: Into The Future
into_the_future.description: You know your spell will be needed not now but in a few moments, so you cast your magic into the future. If your next action is to Cast a Spell that takes 1 or 2 actions to cast, the spell’s effects occur 1 round later, at the beginning of your next turn, rather than immediately. Targets and choices about the spell must be determined when the spell is cast, and requirements, such as line of sight and line of effect, must be valid both when the spell is cast and when its effects occur. Consequences for the action of Casting the Spell itself, such as an Attack of Opportunity reaction or ending a foe’s fascinated condition by taking a hostile action, aren’t delayed.

purge_of_moments.name: Purge Of Moments
purge_of_moments.description: Frequency once per hour All things eventually end, a truth that you can put into practice by accelerating your passage through time to shake off harmful effects. Five rounds of apparent time occur for you. No one, including you, can act during this time, but effects on you run their course, including beneficial effects, negative effects, afflictions, conditions, and persistent damage. Roll saving throws, flat checks, damage, and any other rolls for those effects normally as if the time had passed. Excessive use of this technique is responsible for more than a few premature gray hairs among time mages.

timeline_splitting_spell.name: Timeline-Splitting Spell
timeline_splitting_spell.description: ARCHETYPE CONCENTRATE DIVINATION MANIPULATE METAMAGIC Frequency once per day You invest in two futures, then choose the one to make a reality. You Cast two Spells that each take 1 or 2 actions to cast. These can’t be the same spell heightened to two different levels. You expend the resources for both spells, such as spell slots, Focus Points, and material components. Determine the immediate results for both spells, including attack rolls, saving throws, damage, and any other dice rolls. Then, choose which of the two spells takes effect, using the previously made rolls. The other spell’s resources are still expended, but the spell has no effect as the magic disappears the other timeline. TIME MAGE FOCUS SPELL PATH OF LEAST RESISTANCE FOCUS 4

chronoskimmer_dedication.name: Chronoskimmer Dedication
chronoskimmer_dedication.description: You became partially unstuck from time and have learned how to manipulate your place in flow of time. When you roll initiative, you can choose one of three options: either do nothing and roll initiative normally, stabilize your timestream, or destabilize your timestream and send it into intense fluctuations. If you choose to stabilize your timestream, you don’t roll initiative, and instead your initiative is equal to 10 + your initiative modifier. If you choose to destabilize your timestream, attempt a DC 11 flat check. On a success, your initiative is equal to 19 + your initiative modifier, and on a failure, your initiative is equal to 1 + your initiative modifier. Both stabilizing and destabilizing your timestream are fortune effects. Additionally, if your initiative roll result is tied with an opponent’s initiative roll, you go first. Your manipulation of

turn_back_the_clock.name: Turn Back The Clock
turn_back_the_clock.trigger: You fail a skill check or saving throw.
turn_back_the_clock.description: Frequency once per day After failing a test of skill, you hop back in your personal timeline so you can try again. You reroll the triggering check with a +1 circumstance bonus as you apply your experience from your last attempt. You must use the new result, even if it’s worse than your first roll.

guide_the_timeline.name: Guide The Timeline
guide_the_timeline.description: Frequency once per day You know the result you want and subtly nudge the timeline to your intended destination. Choose an ally or a foe. If you choose an ally, the next time within the next round that ally makes an attack roll or skill check, they roll it twice and take the higher result; this is a fortune effect. If you choose a foe, the next time within the next round that foe makes an attack roll or skill check, they must roll twice and take the lower result unless they succeed at a Will save against your chronoskimmer DC; this is a misfortune effect. Regardless of your choice, the target becomes temporarily immune for 24 hours.

reversing_charge.name: Reversing Charge
reversing_charge.description: You dive into the fray before rewinding yourself to safety. Stride up to your Speed. If you end your movement within melee reach of at least one enemy, you can make a melee Strike against that enemy. You then teleport back to the square from which you began your Snapback Charge. You can use Reversing Charge while Burrowing, Climbing, Flying, or Swimming instead of Striding if you have the corresponding movement type.

superimpose_time_duplicates.name: Superimpose Time Duplicates
superimpose_time_duplicates.description: Frequency once per hour You call alternate versions of yourself, either from a different timeline or perhaps yourself from a different point in your current timeline, to aid you in combat. Until the start of your next turn, these alternate selves flicker in and out in your vicinity, providing flanking for you against all enemies within your reach. Flanking with your time duplicates is the same as flanking with an ally and so is subject to effects like all-around vision or the deny advantage class feature.

borrow_time.name: Borrow Time
borrow_time.description: Frequency once per minute You reach ahead and make use of time that’s yet to be. You become quickened and can use the extra action to Step, Stride, or Strike. You gain this extra action immediately and can use it this turn. At the end of your turn, you become stunned 1.

steal_time.name: Steal Time
steal_time.description: Frequency once per hour You reach into another creature’s timeline and attempt to alter their flow of time. Select a creature within 30 feet. That creature 186186

combat_premonition.name: Combat Premonition
combat_premonition.description: By narrowing your sense of the future, you can improve that of your allies. When you roll initiative, instead of stabilizing or destabilizing your own timestream, you can grant your allies a flash of insight into their future. Choose two allies. Those allies roll their initiative roll twice and take the better result; this is a fortune effect. You roll your initiative roll twice and take the worse result; this is a misfortune effect. The two effects are tied together: if you would avoid the misfortune effect for any reason, or if any of your allies would negate their fortune effect, your Combat Premonition does nothing.

escape_timeline.name: Escape Timeline
escape_timeline.description: Frequency once per day You step outside of the flow of time momentarily, allowing you to avoid dangers. Your physical form stops existing momentarily, and you can’t be targeted or affected until the start of your next turn— you simply don’t exist at that moment in time. Your turn ends immediately, advancing 1 round for all timed durations and effects, such as conditions and afflictions. You still attempt saving throws, flat checks, or any other checks at the end of your turn as normal, but you don’t take any damage due to these checks (though you take any non-damaging effects as normal). At the start of your next turn, you reenter the flow of time and

space_time_shift.name: Space-Time Shift
space_time_shift.description: Frequency once per 10 minutes You travel just a few moments into the future to immediately arrive at your destination. Your Strides are augmented until the end of your turn, allowing you to instantly teleport to any point you could reach with your Stride instead of traversing normally to the location. Your augmented Strides have the teleport trait and don’t trigger reactions that can be triggered by move actions or upon leaving or entering a square. You also augment your Burrow, Climb, Fly, or Swim actions in this way if you have the corresponding movement type.

reset_the_past.name: Reset The Past
reset_the_past.description: Frequency once per day You manipulate time to recharge one of your temporal techniques—by revising your past so you never used it in the first place. Select one of your chronoskimmer feats that has a frequency of once per day (or more frequent) that you’ve already used. You can use the feat again, as if you hadn’t used it already. 187187

psychic_duelist_dedication.name: Psychic Duelist Dedication
psychic_duelist_dedication.prereq: trained in Occultism, you have been in a psychic
psychic_duelist_dedication.description: duel Through experience and in-depth visualizations of mental battles, you’ve grown adept at psychic duels. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your initiative rolls for psychic duels. Each time you enter a psychic duel, choose one of the following benefits for the duration of that duel. • Mind Mace You gain a status bonus to mental damage with spells you cast equal to the spell’s level. • Psychic Fist You can use your standard ability modifier for Strike damage instead of your highest mental modifier, and you can use your full AC instead of using your Will DC in place of your AC. Special You can’t select another dedication feat until you have gained two other feats from the psychic duelist archetype.

duel_spell_advantage.name: Duel Spell Advantage
duel_spell_advantage.description: When you start a psychic duel, you gain a third natural psychic spell. You can’t choose the same spell twice. If you’re 9th level or higher, add the following spells to the list of natural psychic spells you can choose: confusion, crushing despair, hallucination, suggestion, synaptic pulse, and synesthesia.

supreme_psychic_center.name: Supreme Psychic Center
supreme_psychic_center.trigger: Your turn in a psychic duel begins.
supreme_psychic_center.description: With the merest thought, you realign your mental defenses to your duel’s circumstances. You Recenter.

instigate_psychic_duel.name: Instigate Psychic Duel
instigate_psychic_duel.description: ARCHETYPE ILLUSION INCAPACITATION MENTAL OCCULT Frequency once per day You attempt to enter a psychic duel with a creature within 100 feet. The target can attempt a Will save against the higher of your spell DC or class DC. If it enters the duel willingly, use the result for a critical failure. Critical Success The target is unaffected. Success The two of you enter a psychic duel, but it ends automatically at the end of your next turn. As normal for a psychic duel, the duel ends if one participant is knocked out, as well as under any other conditions to which both participants agree. If you’re in initiative when you Instigate the Psychic Duel, you keep the same initiative positions. You can each choose a psychic center for any skill in which you’re trained, as you would if you were using that skill to

mind_smith_dedication.name: Mind Smith Dedication
mind_smith_dedication.description: You’ve learned to imagine a shape in your mind, to envision it so strongly it takes form in the material world. You gain a single melee weapon of your choosing, called a mind weapon. Your mind weapon is a martial melee weapon. The overall shape and design of your mind weapon can be of your choosing but it has one of the following four basic statistics: • A one-handed weapon that deals 1d4 damage and has the agile and finesse traits • A one-handed weapon that deals 1d6 damage and has the finesse trait • A one-handed weapon that deals d8 damage • A two-handed weapon that deals 1d10 damage and has the reach trait Each day during your daily preparations, you can decide if you want your weapon to deal bludgeoning damage and be

malleable_movement.name: Malleable Movement
malleable_movement.prereq: Mind Smith Dedication, expert in Athletics
malleable_movement.description: You shift the shape of your weapon to help you Leap farther and faster. You shift your weapon into a long flexible pole, climbing hook, or similar aid, adding an extra 5 feet to the distance you’re able to Leap. As normal, this can’t increase the distance of your Leap beyond your Speed.

ghost_blade.name: Ghost Blade
ghost_blade.description: Frequency once per hour You alter your weapon’s phase so it can more easily strike incorporeal creatures. Your mind weapon gains the effects of a ghost touch property rune for 1 minute.

just_the_tool.name: Just The Tool
just_the_tool.description: You temporarily change your weapon’s shape to assist you in the field. You morph your weapon into a single simple tool, such as a shovel or crowbar, to help with a mundane task. You can’t replicate entire tool kits with this ability. You can use this action again to change your mind weapon back to a weapon.

mental_forge.name: Mental Forge
mental_forge.description: Your experiences in combat shape your mind’s capability to strengthen and shape your weapon to match the way you move in combat. Choose two of the following weapon traits to give your mind weapon: grapple, modular (B, P, S), nonlethal, shove, or trip. Once chosen, these weapon traits can’t be changed unless you spend 1 week retraining your fighting style to swap one property for another from the list.

mind_shards.name: Mind Shards
mind_shards.description: ARCHETYPE CONCENTRATE ENCHANTMENT MAGICAL MENTAL With a swing and a thought, you detonate your mind weapon into a burst of psychic shards that shred the mind. You concentrate and unleash a 15-foot cone that deals 3d6 mental damage to all creatures in the area, with a basic Will save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC. After the attack, your mind weapon automatically re-forms, and you can’t use this ability again for 1 minute. Mind Shards’ damage increases by 1d6 at level 7 and every two levels thereafter.

malleable_mental_forge.name: Malleable Mental Forge
malleable_mental_forge.description: You open your mind to further weapon customization. During your daily preparations, you can choose any two weapon traits from the Mental Forge feat to place on your weapon for 24 hours or until your next daily preparations (whichever comes first), replacing the traits you chose from the Mental Forge feat. Each day you can swap the choices with any other options on the list.

mind_projectiles.name: Mind Projectiles
mind_projectiles.description: You have learned to stretch your mind’s influence further, releasing projectiles with a swing of your mind weapon. You can make ranged mind weapon Strikes; these are ranged Strikes with a maximum range of 30 feet that deal 1d6 damage of the same type as your mind weapon. Your ranged mind weapon Strike gains all the benefits of your mind weapon’s runes as long as they still apply to a ranged weapon. For example, if your weapon had +1, striking, and spell storing runes, you would get a +1 item bonus to hit with your ranged mind weapon Strike, and it would deal the additional damage from the striking rune, but it wouldn’t be able to unleash a spell from the spell storing rune, as that rune can be etched onto only melee weapons.

runic_mind_smithing.name: Runic Mind Smithing
runic_mind_smithing.description: You focus your mind on thoughtforms of fundamental magical forces, shaping them into a property rune that you mentally etch onto your mind weapon. During your daily preparations, choose one rune from the following list of weapon property runes: corrosive, disrupting , flaming , frost , shock , and thundering. You enhance your weapon with the chosen rune until your next daily preparations. This rune counts toward your maximum limit of runes as normal.

metallic_envisionment.name: Metallic Envisionment
metallic_envisionment.description: You always account for every weakness, allowing your mind to imagine just the right physical form to take advantage of your opponents. Choose between cold iron or silver; all your mind weapon Strikes are treated as the chosen type of metal.

advanced_runic_mind_smithing.name: Advanced Runic Mind-Smithing
advanced_runic_mind_smithing.description: Your mind can hold onto more complicated patterns than ever before. You can etch the greater forms of any runes on the list from the Runic Mind Smithing feat and add them to the list of options you can choose during your daily preparations, as well as the anarchic, axiomatic, holy, or unholy runes. In addition, once per day, you can spend 10 minutes of uninterrupted focus to swap your daily prepared rune from Runic Mind Smithing to another rune from the same list. Once this swap is made, that second rune remains on the weapon until your next daily preparations. 205205

sleepwalker_dedication.name: Sleepwalker Dedication
sleepwalker_dedication.description: You’ve learned to manipulate states of consciousness, beginning with your own. You can send yourself into a half-awake, daydreaming state and gain the Daydream Trance action. Daydream Trance [one-action] (enchantment, mental, occult) You fall into a half-sleeping trance. This lasts for 1 minute or until you fall unconscious, whichever comes first. You can voluntarily end your trance by taking a single action, which has a concentrate trait, and succeeding at a Will save against your own class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher. Once your trance ends, you can’t enter a Daydream Trance again for 1 minute. While you’re in your trance, you gain the following effects: • You gain a +1 status bonus to Will saves. This bonus increases to +2 against mental effects. If you’re legendary in Occultism, the bonus against mental

infiltrate_dream.name: Infiltrate Dream
infiltrate_dream.description: Entering a dream is as natural to you as stepping through a doorway. If you’re adjacent to a sleeping creature, you can enter a lucid dreamlike state, a process taking 10 minutes, to mentally walk into their dreamscape. While in the target’s dream, you witness its contents, plots, and emotional experiences as an observer, though nothing within the dream can perceive or interact with you. Your target becomes temporarily immune to Infiltrate Dream for 1 week. You can’t enter the dreams of a creature that doesn’t have a conscious mind or doesn’t dream. While within the dream, you can attempt an Occultism check against the target’s Will DC to interpret symbolism and learn information about a single topic. If the target has no knowledge of the topic, you learn they don’t know about the topic unless your result is a critical failure. Critical Success You learn a piece of information directly

vision_of_foresight.name: Vision Of Foresight
vision_of_foresight.description: You use your daydreams to predict the success of actions, rapidly envisioning the possibilities. Once before the end of your next turn, you can call upon these predictions before you roll a saving throw or skill check. You can roll the saving throw or skill check twice and take the better result.

dream_magic.name: Dream Magic
dream_magic.description: You learn dream-related magic to aid your studies. Choose dream message or sleep upon taking this feat; you learn this spell as a 4th-level innate occult spell. If you choose sleep, you can cast the spell only while in a Daydream Trance. You become trained in occult spell attack rolls and spell DCs, and your spellcasting ability for these spells is Wisdom. Special You can take this feat twice, gaining the spell you didn’t select initially the second time.

waking_dream.name: Waking Dream
waking_dream.description: While in your trance, you can blur the line between dreams and reality for others. You gain the waking dream focus spell, which you can use only while you’re in a Daydream Trance. You gain a pool of Focus Points with 1 Focus Point and you can Refocus by taking a nap for 10 minutes. You become trained in occult spell attack rolls and spell DCs, and your spellcasting ability for these spells is Wisdom.

oneiric_influence.name: Oneiric Influence
oneiric_influence.description: ARCHETYPE ENCHANTMENT INCAPACITATION MENTAL OCCULT While Infiltrating a Dream, you can also implant a suggestion in the target’s mind. The target must attempt a Will save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher, to resist your modification, which has the effects of a subconscious suggestion spell, but even on a critical success, the target doesn’t realize 206206

ward_slumber.name: Ward Slumber
ward_slumber.description: Just before going to sleep, you can perform a 10-minute ward to protect the slumber of up to eight creatures within 30 feet of you. All creatures affected by the ritual gain a +4 status bonus on saving throws against nightmare, a night hag’s dream haunting, or other effects influencing dreams (such as those provided by this archetype) until your next daily preparations. They heal double the usual amount of Hit Points from resting.

dream_logic.name: Dream Logic
dream_logic.description: You can transmit a sense of dreamy nonchalance. If you do something especially strange or dangerous while you’re in your Daydream Trance, such as entering a restricted area or fighting someone in the street, any creature that isn’t one of your allies must attempt a Perception check against your class or spell DC (whichever is higher). On a success, it realizes something is amiss, and on a failure, it believes nothing is out of the ordinary. The creature can attempt a new check if you start doing something else strange, but not if you continue on the same course of action it already failed to notice was peculiar. Any hostile action by you or your allies against an affected creature automatically ends the effect for that creature. The GM might allow the creature a new check if someone else brings your actions to its attention, such as if

shared_dream.name: Shared Dream
shared_dream.description: You’ve learned to create a shared dreamscape to communicate with others. You can cast dream council as an innate occult spell.

ever_dreaming.name: Ever Dreaming
ever_dreaming.description: You draw no distinction between the sleeping and waking worlds. Your Daydream Trance has an unlimited duration, and you no longer need to take an action to enter it. If you’re unconscious due to sleep, you don’t take the –4 penalty to AC, Perception, and Reflex saves, and don’t have the flat-footed condition. You’re still blinded while asleep. You can act on your turn while asleep, though you’re slowed 2 until you fully awaken. SLEEPWALKER FOCUS SPELL WAKING DREAM FOCUS 4 ENCHANTMENT MENTAL Cast [two-actions] somatic, verbal Range 60 feet; Targets 1 creature Saving Throw Will; Duration sustained up to 1 minute You cloud the target’s mind with vivid, dreamlike imagery, so they have difficulty distinguishing real threats from imagined ones.

dedicacao_de_exorcista.name: Dedicação De Exorcista
dedicacao_de_exorcista.description: Você aprendeu a atrair, reprimir e purificar os espíritos, abrigan- do-os em um receptáculo especial chamado morada espiritual até que estejam prontos para seguir adiante. Por meio do poder de orações ou encantamentos ritualísticos, um objeto mundano em sua posse se torna uma morada espiritual (p. 23). Sua morada es- piritual funciona como uma isca para espíritos perdidos enfraque- cidos pelo tempo que passaram no Plano Material. Todos os dias, durante suas preparações diárias, sua morada espiritual atrai um eco espiritual que vem morar em seu interior. Se a sua morada espiritual não contiver nenhum eco espiritual, você pode gastar 10 minutos em um ritual menor para lançar sua morada espiritual em torno de uma área e atrair outro eco. Você também pode cap- turar resquícios espirituais mais fortes de espíritos mortos-vivos derrotados, conforme explicado na caixa da página 23. Enquanto sua morada espiritual contiver algum espí-
dedicacao_de_exorcista.book: Livro dos Mortos (Book of the Dead)

absolvicao_do_espirito.name: Absolvição Do Espírito
absolvicao_do_espirito.requirements: Você está segurando sua morada espiritual.
absolvicao_do_espirito.description: Custo 1 eco ou resquício espiritual de sua morada espiritual Você purifica um espírito, absolvendo-o de seus pecados e arre- pendimentos. Essa experiência catártica restaura seus pontos de vida ou os de um aliado adjacente. Se você gastar um eco espiri- tual, o alvo recupera 1d4 pontos de vida por nível que você tiver. Se você gastar um resquício espiritual, o alvo recupera 1d6 pontos de vida por nível do morto-vivo incorpóreo ou assombração do qual você obteve o resquício.
absolvicao_do_espirito.book: Livro dos Mortos (Book of the Dead)

expurgar.name: Expurgar
expurgar.description: Você tenta expulsar uma entidade malévola da criatura ou do ob- jeto que ela está possuindo. Faça um teste de neutralização contra o efeito de possessão; para isso, você precisa estar a até 9 metros da criatura ou objeto possuído. O seu nível de neutralização é igual a metade do seu nível, arredondado para cima, e seu modificador de neutralização é seu modificador de Ocultismo, de Religião ou CD de magia –10, o que for maior. Se você for bem-sucedido, a entidade será expulsa e não poderá tentar possuir essa criatura ou objeto outra vez por uma semana. Se falhar, a criatura possessora ficará imune à sua expulsão por um ano e um dia.
expurgar.book: Livro dos Mortos (Book of the Dead)

agonia_do_espirito.name: Agonia Do Espírito
agonia_do_espirito.requirements: Você está segurando sua morada espiritual.
agonia_do_espirito.description: Custo 1 eco ou resquício espiritual da sua morada espiritual Você purifica um espírito, persuadindo-o a liberar sua angústia em um derradeiro uivo catártico. Isso causa dano sônico a todas as criaturas que estiverem em um cone de 9 metros, com um sal- vamento básico de Vontade contra a sua CD de classe ou CD de magia, o que for maior. Se você gastar um eco espiritual, isso causa 1d4 de dano sônico por nível que você tiver. Se você gastar um resquício espiritual, isso causa 1d6 de dano sônico por nível do morto-vivo incorpóreo ou assombração do qual você o obteve.
agonia_do_espirito.book: Livro dos Mortos (Book of the Dead)

morada_convidativa.name: Morada Convidativa
morada_convidativa.description: Sua morada espiritual é particularmente convidativa para ecos espirituais. Durante seus preparativos diários, e sempre que gastar 10 minutos para encontrar mais ecos espirituais, você atrai dois ecos para sua morada espiritual ao invés de um. MORADA ESPIRITUAL E RESQUÍCIOS Uma morada espiritual pode ser qualquer objeto, desde um item cotidiano como um espelho, um sino de mão ou uma pedra preciosa até um dispositivo de relógio personalizado, desde que possa ser segurado com uma mão, seja leve e não tenha outra função (como arma, escudo, consumível ou item mágico). Sua morada espiritual tem o traço da tradição mágica usada para obter a Dedicação do Exorcista e o traço de necromancia. Sua morada espiritual está sintonizada com você, portanto, somente você pode usá-la. Se a sua morada espiritual for perdida ou roubada, você pode trans-
morada_convidativa.book: Livro dos Mortos (Book of the Dead)

dedicacao_de_guardiao_das_almas.name: Dedicação De Guardião Das Almas
dedicacao_de_guardiao_das_almas.prereq: treinado em Ocultismo ou Religião, venera Pha -
dedicacao_de_guardiao_das_almas.description: rasma ou um arrumador psicopompo Você pode dedicar 10 minutos para ornar o símbolo sagrado de Pharasma — um cometa em espiral que representa o caminho si- nuoso que uma alma percorre em sua existência — em um escudo, tabardo, estandarte ou outro objeto de destaque que você use ou empunhe. O símbolo só começa a desvanecer após um ano; porém, se você ornar o símbolo outra vez, quaisquer símbolos previamen- te ornados por você (bem como quaisquer já existentes no item) desaparecem de imediato. O item se torna um símbolo religioso de Pharasma e pode ser usado como um foco divino enquanto estiver ornado. Sempre que uma criatura morta-viva ou alma cativa estiver a até 30 metros desse objeto, a espiral brilha, emitindo luz fraca azul em um raio de 3 metros. Se a criatura estiver se escondendo ou se a alma estiver escondida, ela precisa ser bem-sucedida em
dedicacao_de_guardiao_das_almas.book: Livro dos Mortos (Book of the Dead)

familiar_psicopompo.name: Familiar Psicopompo
familiar_psicopompo.prereq: Dedicação de Guardião das Almas, familiar
familiar_psicopompo.description: Seu familiar se torna um psicopompo mascarado — um guardião extraplanar do ciclo das almas. Esse familiar continua a usar todas as mesmas regras dos outros familiares, mas uma das habilidades 2424 Licenciado para Leonardo Henrique, leonardo.hgma@gmail.com
familiar_psicopompo.book: Livro dos Mortos (Book of the Dead)

magia_de_ciclo.name: Magia De Ciclo
magia_de_ciclo.description: Sua devoção ao ciclo das almas lhe concede uma magia divina adi- cional. Escolha entre benção, armas de disrupção ou curar. Você precisa fazer essa escolha quando adquirir este talento, e ela não pode ser alterada. Uma vez por dia, enquanto sua espiral estiver bri- lhando, você pode conjurar a magia selecionada como uma magia divina inata.
magia_de_ciclo.book: Livro dos Mortos (Book of the Dead)

espiral.name: Espiral
espiral.description: Frequência uma vez a cada 10 minutos Você traça uma espiral no ar enquanto entoa orações para Pha- rasma, recebendo a bênção dela por um tempo. Por 3 rodadas, seus Golpes e magias causam dano adicional contra mortos-vivos, criaturas que estejam em posse de uma alma aprisionada ou cria- turas que você tenha testemunhado criar ou comandar mortos-vivos. Você recebe um bônus de estado no dano com seus Golpes contra essas criaturas igual à quantidade de dados de dano da arma. As magias conjuradas a partir dos seus espaços de magia recebem um bônus de estado no dano contra essas criaturas igual ao nível da magia; esse bônus se aplica somente a magias que causam dano e não têm duração. Se a sua espiral estiver brilhando, você pode visar uma criatura voluntária com a sua luz. Se o fizer, ela recebe esses bônus, em vez de você.
espiral.book: Livro dos Mortos (Book of the Dead)

liberar_alma.name: Liberar Alma
liberar_alma.description: Frequência uma vez por hora A luz flui de seu símbolo de Pharasma para romper os laços que aprisionam uma alma. Você tenta neutralizar um efeito de posses- são ou um efeito, objeto ou magia que esteja aprisionando uma alma (tal como prender alma, a joia da alma, ou as almas devora- das por um devorador). Você precisa estar a até a até 18 metros da criatura ou objeto possuído, ou então do receptáculo que apri- siona a alma. Seu nível de neutralização é igual à metade do seu nível (arredondado para cima), e seu modificador de neutralização é igual à sua CD de classe –10. Se a tentativa falhar, você não poderá usar Liberar Alma contra esse efeito específico outra vez, a menos que as circunstâncias tenham mudado drasticamente, conforme determinado pelo Mestre.
liberar_alma.book: Livro dos Mortos (Book of the Dead)

familiar_psicopompo_melhorado.name: Familiar Psicopompo Melhorado
familiar_psicopompo_melhorado.description: O serviço contínuo de seu psicopompo em nome de Pharasma lhe traz o apoio da deusa. Ele pode mudar de aparência para se parecer com um tipo diferente e mais poderoso de psicopompo. Você pode selecionar quatro habilidades de familiar ou de mestre por dia, em vez de duas, mas duas delas precisam ser do talento Familiar Psicopompo, ou então a seguinte habilidade. • Augúrio Seu familiar consegue vislumbrar os fios do destino para lhe dar uma pista enigmática sobre seu futuro. Ele pode conjurar augúrio uma vez por dia, usando sua tradição mágica e seu CD de magia. Para selecionar esta habilidade, você pre- cisa ser de 8º nível ou maior.
familiar_psicopompo_melhorado.book: Livro dos Mortos (Book of the Dead)

salvaguardar_alma.name: Salvaguardar Alma
salvaguardar_alma.description: Você cingiu sua alma contra interferências externas. Você recebe +2 de bônus de estado em testes contra efeitos de morte, de pos- sessão e efeitos que tentam manipular ou roubar sua alma. Você não pode ser transformado em um morto-vivo de forma alguma. Enquanto sua espiral estiver brilhando, seus aliados que estive- rem sob a luz dela também receberão esse benefício.
salvaguardar_alma.book: Livro dos Mortos (Book of the Dead)

expandir_espiral.name: Expandir Espiral
expandir_espiral.description: Suas orações abrangem seus companheiros, concedendo-lhes a capacidade de compartilhar as bênçãos de Pharasma. Ao usar Juramentado à Espiral, você pode gastar 2 ações, em vez de 1, para conceder os benefícios a todos os aliados que estiverem sob a luz da sua espiral quando você realizar a ação. O CICLO ESPIRITUAL A jornada de uma alma começa no Plano da Energia Positiva, onde as almas vazias se unem aos mortais no Plano Material, juntamente com a essência vital positiva do plano, formando um único ser vivo. No final da vida de um mortal, essas almas entram no Plano Etéreo, pro- gredindo pelo Rio das Almas até o Ossário de Pharasma, onde são julgadas e classificadas para a vida após a morte apropriada. As almas julgadas seguem para seus planos designados, tornando-se peticionários. Esses também
expandir_espiral.book: Livro dos Mortos (Book of the Dead)

mortos_vivos.name: Mortos-Vivos
mortos_vivos.description: Religião Seu treinamento o preparou para reconhecer a maioria dos mortos-vivos à primeira vista. Você se torna treinado em duas perícias de Saber, cada uma so- bre um tipo específico de morto- -vivo, ou se torna um especialista em uma, se já for treinado. Você adquire a ação livre Identifica- ção do Matador. Identificação do Matador [free-action] Acionamento Você joga a iniciativa e pode observar uma criatura que
mortos_vivos.book: Livro dos Mortos (Book of the Dead)

golpe_do_matador.name: Golpe Do Matador
golpe_do_matador.description: ARQUÉTIPO FLOREIO NECROMANCIA OCULTISTA POSITIVO Você se dedicou a estudar técnicas antigas e memorizou pequenas orações contra mortos-vivos para eliminá-los rapidamente. Faça um Golpe contra uma criatura que você sabe que é um morto-vivo. Isso conta como dois ataques para calcular sua penalidade por ataques múltiplos. Se esse Golpe acertar, você causa um dado adi- cional de dano positivo, com o mesmo tamanho de dado da arma ou do ataque desarmado que você usou. Quaisquer outros golpes que você fizer contra a mesma criatura antes do início do seu pró- ximo turno usando a mesma arma ou ataque desarmado causam uma quantidade de dano positivo adicional igual à quantidade de dados da arma. Como o normal, o dano positivo fere apenas mor - tos-vivos e criaturas com cura negativa. No 10º nível, isso aumenta para dois dados adicionais, e no 18º nível para três dados adicionais.
golpe_do_matador.book: Livro dos Mortos (Book of the Dead)

medicina_abencoada.name: Medicina Abençoada
medicina_abencoada.trigger: Você falha em um teste para tratar uma doença
medicina_abencoada.description: que foi causada por um morto-vivo (como febre de carniçal ou podridão de múmia). Sua experiência no combate aos mortos-vivos o preparou de forma única para enfrentar as doenças que eles causam aos sobreviventes, e você sabe que deixar esses males sem tra- tamento acabará resultando em mais mortos-vivos. Rejogue o teste que falhou e use o novo resultado.
medicina_abencoada.book: Livro dos Mortos (Book of the Dead)

resistencia_necromantica.name: Resistência Necromântica
resistencia_necromantica.description: Como parte de seu treinamento, você se protegeu contra a necromancia por meio de uma exposição exaustiva e repetida. Você recebe +1 de bônus de circunstância em salvamentos contra efeitos de necromancia e adquire uma quantidade de resistên- cia a dano negativo igual à metade do seu nível.
resistencia_necromantica.book: Livro dos Mortos (Book of the Dead)

santuario_do_cacador.name: Santuário Do Caçador
santuario_do_cacador.description: de Mortos-Vivos Você estabeleceu um esconderijo de onde pode se preparar para sua caçada. O santuário tem aproximadamente o tamanho de um cubo de 6 metros. Esse santuário fica em um local ao qual você tem acesso e pode fazer parte de uma estrutura maior, como o porão de um templo ou a sala oculta de uma biblio- teca. Instalar ou mover seu santuário requer uma semana de Recesso. Seu santuário pro- tege os objetos e as pessoas dentro dele da detec- ção mágica e dos olhos curiosos dos mortos-vivos. Isso tem os efeitos de indetecção, usando seu modi- ficador de Religião para o CD de neutralização e metade do seu nível arredondado para cima
santuario_do_cacador.book: Livro dos Mortos (Book of the Dead)

amedrontar_morto_vivo.name: Amedrontar Morto-Vivo
amedrontar_morto_vivo.prereq: Dedicação de Matador de Mortos-Vivos, treinado
amedrontar_morto_vivo.description: em Intimidação Sua presença arrepia as criaturas da noite até o âmago delas e você pode usar o poder espiritual e a força vital fiel dos versos religiosos para assustar até mesmo os mortos-vivos acéfalos. Tente desmoralizar um alvo morto-vivo usando seu modificador de Reli- gião, em vez de seu modificador de Intimidação, se este for maior. Se usar seu modificador de Religião, a ação Desmoralizar perderá os traços emoção e mental, pois sua fé se conecta aos mortos-vivos em um nível instintivo.
amedrontar_morto_vivo.book: Livro dos Mortos (Book of the Dead)

equipar_se.name: Equipar-Se
equipar_se.description: Sejam estacas de madeira, água benta, ou ferramentas mais inco- muns, você sempre tem a coisa certa para lidar com as fraquezas e vulnerabilidades incomuns de um morto-vivo. Você adquire os talentos Consumível Presciente e Planejador Presciente (Guia avançado do jogador 204 e 208). Ao usar o Planejador Presciente especificamente para pegar um item necessário para lidar com a fraqueza ou vulnerabilidade de um morto-vivo, você pode pegar o item como uma atividade de 2 ações para remover sua mochila (ou recipiente semelhante) e sacar o item, em vez de levar 1 minuto. Se tiver o talento Santuário do Caçador, você manterá seu san- tuário bem abastecido com o básico e poderá passar 1 hora em seu santuário renovando seus suprimentos para atender aos requisi- tos de Planejador Presciente, mesmo que não tenha conseguido comprar mercadorias.
equipar_se.book: Livro dos Mortos (Book of the Dead)

bencao_do_matador.name: Bênção Do Matador
bencao_do_matador.description: Você carrega restos de materiais perigosos para os mortos-vivos e pode aplicá-los em sua arma. Quando você usar o Golpe do Matador, antes de fazer o Golpe, você pode escolher a runa de propriedade toque fantasma ou um material precioso: ferro frio, madeira escura ou prata. Qualquer Golpe que receba dano positi- vo adicional com esse uso do Golpe do Matador também recebe os benefícios da runa ou conta como esse material. No 14º nível, adicione adamantino e mithral à lista de materiais que você pode escolher.
bencao_do_matador.book: Livro dos Mortos (Book of the Dead)

presenca_do_matador.name: Presença Do Matador
presenca_do_matador.description: Sua presença causa medo nos mortos-vivos. Ao usar Identificação do Matador e ter sucesso no teste, você pode amedrontar mor - tos-vivos como uma ação livre, tendo como alvo a criatura identi- ficada. Sempre que você obtiver um sucesso crítico em Assustar Morto-Vivo, se o nível do alvo for menor que o seu, ele fica fugindo por 1 rodada. MATADORES DE MORTOS-VIVOS NO MAR INTERIOR Assim como os mortos-vivos perseguem suas presas em todo o mundo, os matadores de mortos-vivos vagam por todas as terras da região do Mar Interior, buscando aca- bar com a ameaça e manter as pessoas seguras. Organi- zações como os Cavaleiros de Ultimuro ou a seita pha- rasmina militante chamada Vozes do Pináculo contam com muitos matadores de mortos-vivos em suas fileiras
presenca_do_matador.book: Livro dos Mortos (Book of the Dead)

dedicacao_de_necromante_consagrado.name: Dedicação De Necromante Consagrado
dedicacao_de_necromante_consagrado.prereq: alinhamento bondoso, capacidade de usar magias
dedicacao_de_necromante_consagrado.description: com espaços de magias, capacidade de usar pelo menos uma magia de necromancia, especialista em Religião Você estudou técnicas que lhe permitem misturar a chamada necromancia consagrada em sua própria magia para fortalecer os vivos e destruir os mortos-vivos. Você adquire a magia de foco solo consagrado (p. 29). Conjurar magias de foco custa 1 Ponto de Foco. Este talento concede 1 Ponto de Foco para a sua reserva de foco, que você pode recuperar usando a atividade Refocar (Livro básico 300). Você pode Refocar meditando ou orando para se conectar a canais de energia positiva. As magias de foco do arquétipo necromante consagrado têm a mesma tradição que os seus espaços de magia. Conjurar magias que criam, curam ou de outra forma ajudam ou promovem mortos-vivos é um anátema para você, assim como cooperar com eles. Usar
dedicacao_de_necromante_consagrado.book: Livro dos Mortos (Book of the Dead)

magias_sagradas.name: Magias Sagradas
magias_sagradas.description: Adicione toque gélido, proteção contra morte, armas de disrupção, disrupção de morto-vivo, cascata sagrada, pedra mágica ( Guia avançado do jogador 224), e explosão solar à sua lista de magias. Todas essas são magias de necromancia para você, mesmo que normalmente tenham uma escola de magia diferente. Você pode preparar essas magias ou adicioná-las ao seu repertório da mesma forma que as magias normalmente presentes na lista de magias da sua tradição. Ao obter este talento, você pode retreinar as magias já existentes para substituí-las pelas da lista. Além disso, seu conhecimento sobre os conduítes para o Plano de Energia Positiva lhe permite mais flexibilidade com essas magias. Escolha um dos dois benefícios a seguir. • Se você for um conjurador preparador, poderá gastar 10 mi- nutos para substituir uma das magias que preparou por uma magia do mesmo nível da lista de magias sagradas. Você
magias_sagradas.book: Livro dos Mortos (Book of the Dead)

guardiao_da_morte.name: Guardião Da Morte
guardiao_da_morte.description: Com sua familiaridade íntima com a dualidade da energia positiva e negativa, você consegue de se manter como um baluarte contra a morte e a desmorte. Você adquire uma quantidade de resistên- cia a dano negativo igual à metade do seu nível e +1 de bônus de estado em salvamentos contra efeitos com o traço negativo.
guardiao_da_morte.book: Livro dos Mortos (Book of the Dead)

luminancia_positiva.name: Luminância Positiva
luminancia_positiva.description: Você aprende a criar um reservatório luminoso de energia positiva que pode ser usado para punir mortos-vivos que ousarem atacá-lo. Você adquire a magia de domínio luminância positiva (Livro básico 393). Custa 1 ponto de foco para conjurar uma magia de foco. Este talento concede 1 Ponto de Foco para a sua reserva de foco, que você pode recuperar usando a atividade Refocar.
luminancia_positiva.book: Livro dos Mortos (Book of the Dead)

magia_consagrada_avancada.name: Magia Consagrada Avançada
magia_consagrada_avancada.prereq: Dedicação de Necromante Consagrado, magia de
magia_consagrada_avancada.description: escola inicial de necromante ou magia de domínio da morte inicial Você se aprofunda nas ferramentas mágicas encontradas nas escolas de magia e domínios divinos. Você adquire uma magia de foco avançada, seja a magia da escola avançada de necromante sifonar vida (Livro básico 406) ou a magia de domínio avançado do domínio da morte, erradicar a não-morte ( Livro básico 391). Aumente em 1 a quantidade de pontos de foco em sua reserva de foco. Se você escolher sifonar vida, essa magia é acionada quando você gastar espaços de magia da sua classe, mesmo que não sejam espaços de magia de mago. Especial Você pode selecionar este talento outra vez, esco - lhendo a outra magia de foco avançada.
magia_consagrada_avancada.book: Livro dos Mortos (Book of the Dead)

aura_consagrada.name: Aura Consagrada
aura_consagrada.description: Seu corpo irradia energia positiva, tornando sua presença deso- rientadora para os mortos-vivos e incentivando-os a se afastar de você. O efeito atua sobre os instintos que fluem em seus corpos a partir da energia negativa e, portanto, pode afetar até mesmo criaturas acéfalas. Você adquire uma aura de energia positiva em uma emanação de 6 metros. Cada criatura morta-viva que encer - rar o turno dela dentro da sua aura precisa ser bem-sucedido em um salvamento de Vontade contra a CD da magia, ou ficar ame- drontada 1 (amedrontada 2, em caso de falha crítica). Se a criatura sobreviver, ela fica temporariamente imune por 1 minuto. Especial Sua aura adquire o traço da tradição mágica para as magias que você usou para se qualificar para a Dedicação de Necromante Consagrado. MAGIA DE FOCO DE NECROMANTE CONSAGRADO SOLO CONSAGRADO FOCO 1
aura_consagrada.book: Livro dos Mortos (Book of the Dead)

conviccao_inabalavel.name: Convicção Inabalável
conviccao_inabalavel.prereq: capacidade de criar ou controlar mortos-vivos; clé-
conviccao_inabalavel.description: rigo com fonte negativa, oráculo dos ossos ou mago necromante Sua presença tem um efeito de reforço em seus lacaios mortos-vivos. As criaturas mortas-vivas que estiverem sob seu controle e dentro de uma emanação de 9 metros ao seu redor recebem +2 de bônus de estado em salvamentos para resistir a dano positivo e em salvamen- tos de Vontade para resistir a efeitos que as tornariam controladas. Especial Este talento tem o traço correspondente à sua tradição de conjurador.
conviccao_inabalavel.book: Livro dos Mortos (Book of the Dead)

semblante_do_necromante.name: Semblante Do Necromante
semblante_do_necromante.prereq: capacidade de criar ou controlar mortos-vivos; clé -
semblante_do_necromante.description: rigo com fonte negativa, oráculo dos ossos ou mago necromante A energia necromântica demonstra seu poder sobre os mortos - -vivos, criando um comportamento que impõe medo e respeito . As criaturas mortas-vivas conseguem sentir imediatamente seu Semblante do Necromante e tendem a agir de acordo. Se você rea- lizar uma ação hostil contra uma criatura morta-viva, ela se tor - nará permanentemente imune ao seu Semblante do Necromante e ele se encerrará. Você pode gastar 10 minutos para restaurar seu Semblante do Necromante, embora todas as criaturas que se tornaram permanentemente imunes continuem imunes. Sempre que uma criatura morta-viva de 2 ou mais níveis abaixo do seu atacá-lo, ela precisará fazer um salvamento de Vontade contra a sua CD de magia. Se você também estiver afetado por santuário ou um efeito parecido, apenas um deles afetará o ata- cante (você escolhe qual).
semblante_do_necromante.book: Livro dos Mortos (Book of the Dead)

sublimacao_sepulcral.name: Sublimação Sepulcral
sublimacao_sepulcral.prereq: capacidade de criar ou controlar mortos-vivos; clé -
sublimacao_sepulcral.requirements: Você tem pelo menos um lacaio morto-vivo sob
sublimacao_sepulcral.description: INCOMUM CLÉRIGO CONCENTRAÇÃO MAGO METAMÁGICO NECROMANCIA ORÁCULO rigo com fonte negativa, oráculo dos ossos ou mago necromante seu controle permanente. Você reaproveita a energia negativa que flui através de seus la- caios a qualquer momento. Destrua instantaneamente um lacaio morto-vivo que esteja em um raio de até 18 metros e que esteja permanentemente sob seu controle. Se sua próxima ação for con- jurar uma magia de necromancia a partir de um espaço de magia, você não gasta o espaço. O nível da magia precisa ser de até metade do nível do lacaio destruído e não pode ter duração. Especial Este talento tem o traço correspondente à sua tradição de conjurador. 3333 Licenciado para Leonardo Henrique, leonardo.hgma@gmail.com
sublimacao_sepulcral.book: Livro dos Mortos (Book of the Dead)

dedicacao_de_reanimador.name: Dedicação De Reanimador
dedicacao_de_reanimador.prereq: capacidade de conjurar animar morto a partir de
dedicacao_de_reanimador.description: um espaço de magia Você dedicou seus estudos à arte de criar e comandar mortos-vivos.
